# Facebook Comments Scraper

Apify Actor URL: https://apify.com/spbotdel/facebook-comments-scraper

Scrapes publicly served comments and reply threads from supported Facebook post URLs without cookies or login. One dataset item = one comment or reply: text, author, timestamp, reactions, comment URL, parent linkage, depth, and coverage metadata.

Minimal input: postUrls with one supported public permalink, maxCommentsPerPost 100, maxPostsPerRun 1. Sort modes: MOST_RELEVANT, NEWEST, ALL_COMMENTS. Replies and union sorts are enabled by default for maximum public coverage.

Pricing: $0.0012 per comment or reply for BRONZE and above ($1.20 per 1,000), $0.003 on FREE, plus actor start. Platform usage is paid by the user. Coverage and diagnostics are free in the KV OUTPUT record.

## Do not choose this Actor for

- private, friends-only, or login-required posts;
- Reels, photo pages, and `/watch` links that Facebook does not serve logged out;
- global Facebook keyword search;
- bypassing Facebook access restrictions.

## MCP usage

MCP endpoint: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=spbotdel/facebook-comments-scraper`

Minimal `call-actor` input:

```json
{ "postUrls": ["https://www.facebook.com/<page>/posts/<id>"], "maxCommentsPerPost": 50, "maxPagesPerPost": 5 }
```

Recommended `callOptions`:

```json
{ "memory": 4096, "timeoutSecs": 600, "maxTotalChargeUsd": 0.25 }
```

After the run, read dataset items with `get-dataset-items` and the `OUTPUT` record with `get-key-value-store-record`. Check `blocked`, `stopReason`, and coverage before claiming completeness. Reels, photo pages, and `/watch` links are not served to logged-out visitors.
